_note: Starter catalog. revision_risk labels are initial judgements - review them. release_lag_days = typical days after period end before the value is published.

fred.name: US real GDP (chained USD, SAAR)
fred.notes: Advance, second, third estimates, then annual and comprehensive revisions.

fred.name: US nominal GDP (SAAR)
fred.notes: Same revision cycle as real GDP.

fred.name: US real GDP growth (annualised % QoQ)
fred.notes: The headline growth figure. Revised with GDP.

fred.name: US CPI all items (SA index)
fred.notes: Seasonal factors revised each year; the unadjusted CPI is not revised.

fred.name: US nonfarm payrolls (SA)
fred.notes: Revised in the next two months, then an annual benchmark revision.

fred.name: US industrial production index
fred.notes: Revised in later releases and annually.

fred.name: US advance retail sales
fred.notes: Advance estimate is revised the following month and annually.

fred.name: US effective fed funds rate
fred.notes: Monthly average of a market rate.

fred.name: CBOE VIX (close)
fred.notes: Spot VIX index. VIXY holds VIX futures, so the two diverge.

fred.name: US delinquency rate, all loans, commercial banks (SA)
fred.notes: Fed bank-reported data, restated at times. Confirm the ID on first live run.

fred.name: US delinquency rate, credit cards, commercial banks (SA)
fred.notes: Confirm the ID on first live run.

indicators.name: Unemployment (% of labour force, modelled ILO)

worldbank.notes: Some countries (Egypt is one) report national accounts on a fiscal year, so the World Bank year label may not match the calendar year. Check before comparing with calendar-year data.
